newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices, and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 969 million yuan from 577 million yuan last Friday with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was more active than Friday with non-banking financial institutions traded actively through the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traders said.
"The strong performance of domestic A shares sharply fanned fund demand for those non-banking financial institutions, including securities houses," said one trader.
State banks largely stayed on the sidelines, traders said.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move in a narrow range with volume picking up in the next few days.
